title: Trillions are being ‘wasted’ on the AI boom, Arthur Hayes says. He’s betting on what comes next
summary_full: Former BitMEX CEO Arthur Hayes says the AI infrastructure boom is being overbuilt and is betting an eventual crash and bailout will send crypto higher.
summary_public: Former BitMEX CEO Arthur Hayes says the AI infrastructure boom is being overbuilt and is betting an eventual crash and bailout will send crypto higher.
